decision: Retain borrowed schema-environment finalization with all validation and generated bytes unchanged
hardware: Apple M3 Air, 8 cores (4P+4E), 16 GB, macOS 26.2
scope: Four serial ABBA fresh full source-to-Object observations with identical 54 existing runtime flags and host statistics. Compiler bootstrap, screen, tests, fixtures, diagnostic census and archiving are excluded. No competing work from this campaign overlaps primary timing.

The owned finalizer and new finalize_ref/finalize_body methods use the same canonicalizer and ordered validation. The complete dimension environment is borrowed instead of cloned; the body is still owned. No semantic proof, catalog or factory-selection result is cached.

Every declaration is still validated, including unused malformed declarations. Contract tests preserve component axis relationships, renumbering, bounds, original error precedence and visibility of draft mutation.

All source, MBC, Object and complete metadata bytes match the current qualified reduction-rotation control in every primary observation and separate screen. All four outputs also match between subjects in six complete array/enum and eight checked scalar programs.

All 357 Core, contract, serde-vector, frontend and codec tests pass, along with Core no_std checking. The initial no-default-feature canonical-vector target runs zero tests because of its serde gate; only the explicit two-test serde run counts as vector coverage.

Compiler time, frontend time, retired instructions and peak RSS improve in this matched cohort. All unchanged-stage variation, including adverse native-stage observations, remains without causal attribution to this frontend change. Four compiles are descriptive, not a population estimate.

A separate frozen-Object census observes 358 functions, 234 distinct byte/raw-relocation groups and 124 duplicate functions beyond the first. It includes inter-function alignment and is not an IR-equivalence proof or a validated backend cache key. No cached compilation is used.

No new runtime-latency campaign is claimed; main/helper machine code and complete metadata remain byte-identical. State-fixture assembly provenance includes earlier attempts, not a new fragment-only launch.
Grammar, language, current-visit/ownership checks, finite admission and backend optimization level are unchanged. Full fresh compilation remains above ten seconds.
